text:
Miami Gardens bụ obodo dị na Miami-Dade County, Florida, nke e guzobere na 2003 ma bụrụ ụlọ Hard Rock Stadium, nke mepere afọ ole na ole gara aga na 1987. Obodo nta ahụ dị n’ime Greater Miami metropolitan area, otu n’ime ụzọ United States na-abanye Latin America na Caribbean.

Omenala bọọlụ n’akụkụ Florida a adabereghị na mpaghara Miami Gardens kama na Greater Miami metro gbara ya gburugburu. Miami so n’ime ahịa kacha nwee mmasị na bọọlụ na United States, nke ndị Latin American na Caribbean diaspora na-akpali. Obodo ahụ bụ ụlọ Inter Miami CF, klọb nke Lionel Messi sonyere na 2023, ma na-adọta egwuregwu mba ụwa na asọmpi dị ukwu mgbe niile. Akụkọ ihe mere eme ahụ ka e dere na Hard Rock Stadium, ebe e mere ma 2024 Copa America Final na egwuregwu nke 2025 FIFA Club World Cup. Ole na ole n’ime obodo America na-ebute ụdị ihe nketa bọọlụ dị elu a na 2026 World Cup, ma ole na ole ka na-eme ya site na ndị na-akwado ya nwere njikọ chiri anya na omenala bọọlụ nke Americas. Na Miami Gardens, obodo dị ihe na-erughị afọ iri abụọ, egwuregwu zuru ụwa ọnụ na-ahụ otu n’ime ụlọ ya kacha eke.
